naturalSplitPoints.title: 27-2 — Store listing, assets, and policy compliance
contains: Export Figma page `30 — Store Assets` at exact sizes: 440×280 tile, 1400×560 marquee, five 1280×800 screenshots, icons 16/32/48/128 (the icons already exist via `pnpm icons:brand`; ADR 0016 line ~136 says store assets consume that same tile and must not be redrawn).

Arabic and English listing copy: name, short description from Docs/Rasd_Ar.md:930, full description led by the §37 promise 'شاهد المشكلة، حدّدها، قِسها، وقارنها ثم أرسلها' (Rasd_Ar.md:936), category Developer Tools, supported languages.

Permission justification fields, copied from REQUIRED_PERMISSION_RATIONALE / OPTIONAL_PERMISSION_RATIONALE / HOST_PERMISSION_RATIONALE — which first requires phase 25 to rewrite HOST_PERMISSION_RATIONALE and to settle the `offscreen` binary decision (Rasd_Plan.md:1666-1667).

Data-use disclosure ('لا تُجمع بيانات' where true, precise disclosure of the optional GitHub integration), privacy policy published at a stable public URL, compliance questionnaire, single-purpose and minimum-permission policy review item by item.
Staged rollout setup and an unlisted channel.
naturalSplitPoints.whyThisBoundary: Zero code, entirely blocked on phase 25's outputs and on a Chrome Web Store developer account, and its language decisions depend on 26أ's ruling about whether page-30 screenshots stay English. Different blockers, different skills, different failure modes than 27-1 — merging them means the whole of 27 stalls on an account application.
naturalSplitPoints.verifiableBy: A dimension-check script over store/ asserting each asset's exact pixel size (same IHDR-read technique verify-dist.mjs already uses on icons), plus ar/en listing files present and the privacy-policy URL returning 200.

naturalSplitPoints.title: 28-1 — RC build and acceptance matrix
contains: Pin an RC version — first resolving that Chrome MV3 manifest `version` accepts only 1–4 dot-separated integers, so '1.0.0-rc.1' cannot go in the manifest as written in the plan; decide version_name or an integer RC scheme.
Build and publish to the unlisted channel; run the 48-cell matrix (3 OS × stable/beta × dpr 1|2 × dark/light × rtl/ltr).
Manual acceptance of the three journeys in §29–31 from a user's point of view.
Upgrade test (install prior version, create data, upgrade, verify no data loss and no migration failure), clean-install test, uninstall test (no residue, reinstall starts clean).
Playwright MCP run of the four prototype paths against the BUILT package, not the dev build.
Triage feedback into blocking / 1.0.1 / 1.1; fix blockers only; rc.2 if needed.
naturalSplitPoints.whyThisBoundary: This is the judgment half of 28 and the only part that needs real hardware and a live store channel. Its context cost is dominated by reading failure reports, not by reading code.
naturalSplitPoints.verifiableBy: A filled matrix with 48 recorded cells, zero blocking defects open, and the upgrade/clean-install/uninstall tests each recorded pass with the command or steps used.

naturalSplitPoints.title: 28-2 — Staged publish and v1.0 close-out
contains: Publish 1.0.0 at 10% → 50% → 100% with crash-report monitoring between steps.
Final CHANGELOG, `v1.0.0` git tag, open the 1.1 track with the deferred items the plan names: browser-window capture, cloud share links, Linear and Jira, live collaboration, advanced multi-page PDF.
Close out §9 status rows and re-publish Docs/Phases/Dashboard.html at its fixed URL per Constitution §8 item 9.
naturalSplitPoints.whyThisBoundary: Publishing is calendar-bound — you wait between rollout steps. Splitting it off means 28-1's fix work is not held open across days of monitoring.
naturalSplitPoints.verifiableBy: `git tag -l v1.0.0` non-empty; store item at 100%; Dashboard.html updated at the same URL with 28 marked complete.

planClaimsRefutedByCode.claim: 'تُنفَّذ على جزأين متعاقبين' with 26أ requiring: 'إغلاق قائمة المراجعة البصرية للصفحات 15–27 — لم تُراجَع بصريًا بعد (مُسجَّل في ذيل §6)' and 'إصلاحات capture / area-select و capture / error و capture / full-page التي سقطت عند حدّ نداءات MCP'.

planClaimsRefutedByCode.claim: '`tests/visual-baselines/` يقف عند `phase-08` (ثلاث مراحل فقط)، ولا يقرؤه أي كود اليوم'
planClaimsRefutedByCode.reality: Five phase directories exist, not three: phase-05, phase-07, phase-08, phase-15, phase-18 — 16 files. phase-15 and phase-18 were added after that sentence was written. The 'no code reads it' half is still true for comparison, but two scripts WRITE into it and CI uploads it.
planClaimsRefutedByCode.evidence: `find tests/visual-baselines -type f | wc -l` → 16, across 5 phase dirs. Writers: scripts/verify-editor.mjs:1569 (`join(root,'tests','visual-baselines','phase-15')`) and scripts/verify-library.mjs:494 (phase-18). Reader: .github/workflows/ci.yml:211 uploads `tests/visual-baselines/` as an artifact. Nothing compares. Note Rasd_Plan_Audit.md:134 carries the same stale '9 ملفات لثلاث مراحل' count.

planClaimsRefutedByCode.claim: '**26أ:** لا شيء — قابلة للتشغيل موازيةً في أي وقت' (dependencies: none, runnable in parallel any time), repeated at Rasd_Plan.md:1731, :1769, :2192 and in ADR 0013.
planClaimsRefutedByCode.reality: True for 15 of the 16 live §6 rows, but NOT for row 10. Row 10 is a token-value decision that must be made in Figma; its resolution re-captures figma-snapshot.json, regenerates public/assets/tokens.css, and shifts every light-mode screen's pixels. So 26أ is not order-free with respect to 26ب's baselines — the plan's own 26ب dependency list even acknowledges the general principle ('24 و25 — إصلاحاتهما تغيّر البكسلات فعلًا، والتقاط خطوط الأساس قبلهما يعني التقاطها مرّتين') without applying it to 26أ itself.
planClaimsRefutedByCode.evidence: Rasd_Plan.md:1985 (row 10) assigns the decision to phase 26 and forbids hand-editing tokens.css per ADR 0007. The value is live: public/assets/tokens.css:12 `--rasd-color-ink-600: #687c87;` bound to --rasd-text-tertiary in both light-mode blocks (lines 312 and 418). scripts/tokens-sync.mjs writes tokens.css from the snapshot, so changing the source necessarily rewrites the shipped stylesheet.

planClaimsRefutedByCode.claim: brand-icons.mjs header: 'لماذا خارج CI: ... نفس علّة `verify:popup` (غير مُدرج في CI أيضًا)'
planClaimsRefutedByCode.reality: The decision itself still stands and is correctly recorded, but its supporting analogy is now stale: verify:popup IS in CI. All 17 verify guards were added to the live matrix on 2026-09-10 (§6 row 97). The icons:brand decision's real, current justification is the ADR 0016 line, not the verify:popup comparison.
planClaimsRefutedByCode.evidence: The decision, quoted from Docs/ADR/0016-mark-geometry-single-source.md:110 — '| إدراج `icons:brand --check` في CI | فشل كاذب عند ترقية المتصفّح — البند 4، والسابقة مسجَّلة في `phase-15/README.md` |'. And from scripts/brand-icons.mjs itself — 'الترسيم يحتاج Chrome حقيقيًا، وناتج البكسل قد يختلف بين إصدارَي متصفّح بلا تغيّر في المصدر — فمقارنة البايت في CI تُنتج فشلًا كاذبًا'. Contradicting the analogy: .github/workflows/ci.yml matrix contains `- { guard: popup, blocking: false }`. Confirmed also that icons:brand appears nowhere in ci.yml, gate-a.mjs, or the `check` script — grep over .github/, scripts/gate-a.mjs, package.json returns only package.json:31 (the script definition) and ADR 0016.

planClaimsRefutedByCode.claim: zip.mjs docstring: 'يحزم `dist/` في ملف مضغوط جاهز للرفع، **بعد تمرير فحص الحزمة**'
planClaimsRefutedByCode.reality: No bundle check is performed. The script checks only that dist/ exists as a directory, then shells out to `zip`. verify-dist.mjs is never imported or spawned. The check happens only because `pnpm build` runs verify:dist at the end — so `pnpm zip` on a stale or hand-modified dist/ packages it unverified.
planClaimsRefutedByCode.evidence: Full file is 24 lines. Its only execFileSync is `execFileSync('zip', ['-r','-q','-X', out, '.'], { cwd: dist })`. package.json:53 `"zip": "node scripts/zip.mjs"` — no chained verify.

planClaimsRefutedByCode.claim: ADR 0016: 'تُقيَّد المراحل اللاحقة: أصول المتجر (**المرحلة 26**) تستهلك المربّع نفسه'
planClaimsRefutedByCode.reality: Store assets belong to phase 27, not 26. Phase 26 is Visual QA vs Figma; phase 27 is 'بناء الإنتاج وجاهزية Chrome Web Store' and its body is what names `30 — Store Assets`.
planClaimsRefutedByCode.evidence: Rasd_Plan.md:1801 (inside المرحلة 27 body): 'أصول المتجر من `30 — Store Assets`: الأيقونات 16/32/48/128، وبطاقة 440×280، وشريط 1400×560، وخمس لقطات 1280×800'. Phase 26's body (lines 1721-1788) never mentions store assets.

planClaimsRefutedByCode.claim: ADR 0016: 'الحزمة لم تتأثّر — قِس 874.7 KB عبر 47 ملفًّا'
planClaimsRefutedByCode.reality: Drift, not an error at time of writing: the bundle is now 1.1 MB across 57 files. Phases 14/16/17 added the compare page and two workers since. Relevant because phase 27 must set a size ceiling and this is the only recorded prior measurement.
planClaimsRefutedByCode.evidence: `find dist -type f | wc -l` → 57; `du -sh dist` → 1.1M. New entries visible in dist/assets/: compare.js, compare.css, diff.worker.js, blur.worker.js, regions.js.

openQuestions: Frame count: is it 57 or 60? The §0.3 screens table (Rasd_Plan.md:37-53) sums to 57 across the 15 product pages (popup 10, capture 5, editor 3, measure 2, inspect 2, colors 5, compare 4, library 10, projects 2, export 2, share 2, integrations 1, settings 4, privacy 1, onboarding 4), but its own header says '60 إطارًا عبر 15 صفحة منتج' and 26ب's completion criterion says 'كل الشاشات الستين مراجَعة'. Someone has to decide whether three frames are missing from the table or the number 60 is wrong, before a completion criterion can be checked at all.

What is a visual baseline FOR, given that pixel comparison is already rejected by decision? tests/visual-baselines/phase-15/README.md rejects it, ci.yml repeats the rejection ('خطُّ أساسٍ بكسليّ على متصفّح يتغيّر شهريًّا يُنتج فشلًا كاذبًا أكثر ممّا يُنتج كشفًا'), and §6 row 74 notes the phase-07 baseline recorded a shipped bug for eleven phases without anyone noticing — 'مرجعٌ يحمل خللًا ليس مرجعًا'. 26ب's text ('تحديث خطوط الأساس البصرية بعد كل تصحيح') presumes a comparator that was deliberately never built. Resolve this before capturing baselines for phases 6/9/10/11, or the sub-phase produces 20 more unread PNGs.

Chrome MV3 manifest `version` accepts only 1–4 dot-separated integers, so phase 28's '1.0.0-rc.1' cannot be the manifest version as written, and verify-dist.mjs hard-enforces manifest.version === package.json version. Does the RC use `version_name`, or an integer scheme (e.g. 0.9.x), or does verify-dist gain an exception? The plan does not say.

Does 27 wait for 25, or does 25's carry-in move? Phase 27's store submission needs (a) HOST_PERMISSION_RATIONALE rewritten — it still promises 'قراءة أوراق الأنماط الخارجية' in src/shared/permission-policy.ts — and (b) the `offscreen` binary decision (src/offscreen/ is index.html + README.md with zero scripts, yet 'offscreen' is in REQUIRED_PERMISSIONS). Rasd_Plan.md:1667 says the drop must happen 'قبل المرحلة 27'. Both are phase-25 items. Either 27 is hard-blocked on 25, or these two move into 27-2 explicitly.

Is the Vite/Rollup output itself byte-deterministic across clean builds? Phase 27 promises 'نفس المصدر يعطي نفس الحزمة بايتًا ببايت'. Fixing zip.mjs's timestamps and entry order is necessary but not sufficient — content hashes in chunkFileNames/assetFileNames must also be stable. This has never been measured here (dist-zip/ does not exist; pnpm zip has never run). Measure it before writing it into a completion criterion.

Store screenshots: Arabic or English? The user's memory file lists this as open item 2 ('Page 30 store screenshots are English — plausible for a Chrome Web Store listing, but unconfirmed'), and it collides with the broader open item 1 (doc pages 02/06/08/09/11/32 are English-primary while page 32 itself asserts Arabic is the product language). This is a 26أ ruling that determines 27-2's asset export, so it should be answered in 26أ-1, not discovered in 27.

Should 26أ and 26ب merge? 26أ is now small (most of it executed out-of-band) and 26ب's first mandatory step depends on 26أ's row-10 token decision. Merging them into one phase 26 with an internal ordering constraint is defensible. Against merging: the model assignment differs by design (26أ Opus 5 for design judgment, 26ب Sonnet 5 for volume), the MCP call-budget management that 26أ explicitly asks for ('تُقسَّم على جلسات بحدّ معلَن لكل جلسة') argues for keeping the Figma work in its own session, and 26ب-2's frames are blocked on phases that have not started. Recommendation: keep them separate but run 26أ-1 immediately, since it is the only unblocked remaining work in this whole area.

The live-Chrome CI matrix has all 17 guards non-blocking with a documented promotion rule of 'عشر جولات خضراء متتالية' (§6 row 97), and the plan puts resolution of the flakiness in phase 23. Phase 27's test list demands 'Playwright MCP: تشغيل المسارات الأربعة على الحزمة المبنيّة' and phase 28 demands 'سيناريوهات E2E كلها خضراء على حزمة rc'. If 23 has not converted any guard to blocking by then, what does 'كلها خضراء' mean for a suite where the set of failures moves every run?
